raw_event: Web gateway recorded a sharp rise in inbound requests from one external address.
Automated sign-in attempt failed during the request burst.
Another automated sign-in attempt failed from the same source.
Third automated sign-in attempt failed from the same source.
The gateway recorded approximately 4,800 requests per minute from the external source.
Edge firewall blocked requests that exceeded the rate limit.
New connection attempts continued after the first rate-limit block.
Firewall blocked a second high-rate connection group.
Availability monitor reported elevated response times for the public portal.
Firewall continued blocking bursts while the portal recovered.
Inbound request rate returned toward its normal range.
